title: Explosions reported at power plant, synthetic rubber factory in Russia's Tula Oblast following drone attack
summary: Tula Oblast Governor Dmitry Milyayev said on Telegram that Russian air defenses had downed four Ukrainian drones over the region, adding that the threat of further drone attacks remained.

title: Trump adds Ukraine to warning against expanding war, diverging from joint NATO statement
summary: A NATO official speaking on condition of anonymity told Politico that both sides had agreed to the original statement, indicating that Trump had subsequently changed the wording unilaterally.

title: Starshield restrictions still hampering Ukraine's drone defenses, Zelensky tells BBC
summary: Zelensky also expressed frustration over delays in American deliveries of Patriot air defense interceptors, saying Ukraine continued to face a severe shortage of missiles capable of stopping Russian ballistic attacks.

title: Armenia plans full withdrawal of Russian border guards in coming years, prime minister says
summary: Russian border guards, operating under Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB), have helped protect Armenia's borders with Turkey and Iran under a bilateral agreement signed in 1992.

title: Ukrainian man in critical condition after setting himself on fire in central Warsaw
summary: The man received emergency medical assistance and was taken to the hospital with severe burns. He remains in intensive care, according to the Ukrainian embassy.
